evidence.testTitle: DB-001: public registration commits one complete canonical identity with independent credentials and empty privilege defaults across recreation
evidence.scenarioScope: Public REST registration creates a complete canonical account/nickname/PBKDF2/SCRAM identity with ordinary privilege defaults, verified independently and after full workerd recreation.
evidence.rationale: Actual passed frozen12 test, public authentication with independent random passwords, real Worker SQLite and IRC/event recipients; read-only wrapper diagnostics never supply operation authorization or fabricated successful writes.
assertionDetails: An independently credentialed Alice/Bob/Charlie fixture supplies actual authorized and outsider IRC/event witnesses plus an unrelated seeded channel. Duplicate canonical ALICE, short password, reserved NickServ, and injected roles requests each return400; protected account/nickname/credential/role/settings/session/ticket tables remain identical and all six live IRC/event observer windows contain only the allowed barrier.

Delta public registration201 creates one UUID identity with username Delta/canonical delta, credential_version0, explicit display name, created_at=updated_at matching response and bounded actual operation time, disabled_at null; exactly one SCRAM and one registered_nicks row reference that same ID and timestamp.

Independent Node PBKDF2 derivation matches the stored password hash and rejects Alice foreign password; independent PBKDF2/HMAC/SHA256 derives the actual SCRAM stored/server keys. Ordinary registration creates zero account role rows, zero API sessions, and no eager account_settings row (settings use lazy defaults). Existing independent accounts and all unrelated channel persistent state stay unchanged.

After stopping workerd, independent Node SQLite reads the same user/SCRAM rows. A new workerd using persisted state rereads identical identity tables; mixed-case dElTa public login yields the same ID/empty roles and one token hash mapped to that ID. Real IRC PASS/Delta JOIN stores the same user ID and actual private publication reaches authorized Alice/Bob IRC/events, excluding Charlie, while unrelated channel state remains.
coverageLimitations: Main public REST registration and subsequent REST login/IRC PASS are covered; other protocol registration aliases and all configuration/bootstrap/invite policy variants are not retested. Account settings are lazy rather than a fabricated required eager row. Public account registration does not auto-create an API session.

evidence.testTitle: DB-002: recreated workerd reads each persisted credential and rejects swapped foreign and wrong passwords without durable sessions or protected output
evidence.scenarioScope: Original and recreated workerd use the correct independently generated persisted credentials, rejecting swapped/foreign/wrong/unknown account attempts without durable login credentials or protected publications.
evidence.rationale: Actual passed frozen12 test, public authentication with independent random passwords, real Worker SQLite and IRC/event recipients; read-only wrapper diagnostics never supply operation authorization or fabricated successful writes.
assertionDetails: Alice and Bob use different random public-registration passwords. Original successful REST login and actual IRC PASS/membership/delivery serve as positive controls; independently seeded Charlie channel and three real IRC/event observers remain live through barriers.

Before and after complete workerd recreation, swapped Alice/Bob passwords, a random wrong Alice password and a missing username each return401 (eight denials total) without account/token result, changing no users/nicks/PBKDF2/SCRAM/role/settings rows and adding no API session/event-ticket row. Actual requester-denial observer windows are silent on all live IRC/event streams except the explicit subsequent allowed barrier.

Stopped SQLite after original denials contains exactly the three legitimate API sessions. Recreated workerd rereads unchanged credential identities; existing legitimate bearer credentials and real newly connected IRC PASS accounts continue authorized private deliveries, with no outsider protected content.

Fresh mixed-case ALICE/BoB logins after recreation return their respective original canonical IDs; distinct new token hashes map to the correct independent users. Unrelated channel metadata, founder grants, roles and messages remain identical through both phases.
coverageLimitations: Public REST credential verification and positive IRC PASS are covered; negative SASL/IRC credentials and every other authentication alias are outside this test. Authentication rate-limit counters may legitimately change and are not treated as forbidden identity/session artifacts.

evidence.testTitle: DB-017 DB-024: committed message keys and unique role assignments survive reconstruction and replay without duplicate rows sequences or recipient delivery
evidence.scenarioScope: Real scoped message idempotency keys and role composite assignment uniqueness under concurrency and post-commit/full-recreation retries.
evidence.rationale: Actual passed frozen12 test, public authentication with independent random passwords, real Worker SQLite and IRC/event recipients; read-only wrapper diagnostics never supply operation authorization or fabricated successful writes.
assertionDetails: Twelve real concurrent POST requests using the implemented idempotency-key header commit one canonical message ID/sequence1, one exact SQL sender/body and exactly one IRC and event publication to each authorized Alice/Bob recipient; Charlie gets none. The same key used by a second real account and in a second secret channel yields four distinct account/channel-scoped canonical IDs; both channels have exact unique sequences1,2 and matching SQL sender IDs/content.

Eight concurrent legitimate founder assignment requests against an actual role/user pair return200 and commit exactly one channel_user_roles composite row plus one assignment publication per authorized event recipient. The role group is created through the authorized public REST operation; no fake isAdmin input is used.

Runtime is stopped after commits; independent SQLite reads exact canonical message and assignment rows. Fresh workerd and fresh IRC/event sockets preserve all target role/assignment/message/metadata rows. Post-commit replay returns the exact original message object, role assignment returns200 without changing assigned_at/row count, conflicting same-key content400 and outsider message/role mutations403 produce no additional IRC/event publication in bounded live observer windows.

After reconstruction/replay the two secret channels and unrelated independent Charlie channel preserve their exact durable metadata/grants/roles/message rows. The next genuine new keyed message receives sequence3 and is delivered only to authorized recipients. These are explicit implemented message-key and role-composite contracts; unkeyed identical text is not claimed idempotent.
coverageLimitations: Only the implemented idempotency-key message contract and role assignment uniqueness are covered; arbitrary operations, crash injection between commit and response, provider retries and all concurrency interleavings are not established. The test recreates after a completed successful commit.

evidence.testTitle: DB-017: concurrent role deletion assignment and sends preserve exact accepted messages and absent privileges after full workerd recreation
evidence.scenarioScope: Concurrent founder role deletion, assignment and ordinary-member sends preserve exact committed messages and absent deleted privileges before and after full process reconstruction.
evidence.rationale: Actual passed frozen12 test, public authentication with independent random passwords, real Worker SQLite and IRC/event recipients; read-only wrapper diagnostics never supply operation authorization or fabricated successful writes.
assertionDetails: Public ordinary Alice creates a moderated secret channel and legitimate voice/send_messages role, assigns real Bob, and Bob sends an actually delivered positive control. A real DELETE races eight REST sends and four assignments. Every actual201 send ID/body/sequence is collected; safe before/after linearization outcomes are accepted, while exact stored canonical sender/ID/content/sequence rows must equal only the collected successful set.

Each of eight uniquely marked racing bodies is mapped to its actual HTTP status and each201 canonical ID/sequence. After actual authorized deletion events, successful private delivery and a final live all-recipient barrier, all400 bodies are absent from all three IRC and all three event streams; each committed canonical ID (including the prior positive control) appears exactly once on each authorized IRC/event peer. Charlie receives no race marker, role ID/name, private channel MODE, role deletion or assignment event. The focused run accepted0 racing sends; no other schedule is claimed.

After deletion, REST send400, real IRC send404, repeated founder assignment to missing group404 and ordinary-member role assignment403 are bracketed by live authorized/outsider IRC/event windows and emit no protected publication (only the requester IRC404 is allowed). Actual role group/assignment rows are empty; Bob still has exactly one real membership with no derived privilege mode, and the exact original Alice founder-q grant is unchanged.

Stopped independent SQLite shows no deleted role/assignment. Recreated workerd/new authenticated sockets repeat the same denials and exact state/recipient assertions, retain unrelated Charlie channel durable rows, and accept a new healthy founder message at the next canonical sequence.
coverageLimitations: One actual observed race linearization is covered, not exhaustive scheduling or all operation classes. This is orderly complete process recreation after the transition, not a provider crash/kill durability guarantee.

remainingScope: No exhaustive concurrent scheduling, all RPC/operation idempotency, provider-crash recovery, or deployed verification.
No idempotency claimed for unkeyed identical REST text; implemented message idempotency-key and role composite uniqueness only.
Protocol registration aliases and negative SASL/IRC credential paths remain covered, if at all, by other separately executed proofs.
Account settings have documented lazy defaults; this test proves no eager settings row rather than requiring an invented row.
